messages:
Alex: Morning — quick preflight capacity check for today's deploy window. What I did: validated reserved pool sizes in us-west1 and eu-west1, kicked off a small canary, and ran the regional quota audit. Blockers: seeing a weird spike in prewarm latency in EU that might be quota related. Today: follow up with GCP quota ticket and confirm fallback policy.

Maya: Thanks. Can you paste the audit command you ran? I'll compare to last week's numbers.

Alex: Ran: `gcloud compute regions describe eu-west1 --project=redwood-prod` and `kubectl get nodes -l redwood/gpu -o json | jq '.items | length'` — got 62 GPU nodes eu-west1, 120 us-west1.

Sam: Noted — we have higher pending requests in eu-west1 between 07:00-08:30 UTC. Could be autoscaler not triggering fast enough. I pushed a small autoscaler tweak in infra-ops branch.

Chris: FYI I saw ~15 failed prewarm attempts in logs, error: `insufficientQuota` for `nvidia-tesla-t4` in eu-west1-b. Filing ticket now.

Nora: Ticket #INC-1042 created with GCP support. They asked for project ID and quota region; I included the `gcloud` output. ETA 4-6 hours.

Alex: Cool. For canary we fell back to cpu-quantized model in us-west1; latency rose ~30ms but throughput steady. Rolling back to reserved GPU pool isn't necessary yet.

Maya: Quick CR ping @Sam — `autoscaler.tf` change needs an import of the existing policy before apply, otherwise it creates a duplicate. Left comment on the PR.

Sam: Saw it, fixing. Also adding a preapply check script:```bash
#!/bin/bash
terraform import module.autoscaler.google_compute_autoscaler.autoscaler projects/.../regions/us-west1/autoscalers/my-autoscaler || true
tfsec || true
terraform plan -var='commit=${CIRCLE_SHA1}'
```

Chris: For mitigations — suggestion: enable regional fallback routing in the policy so requests go to us-west1 if eu-west1 capacity < 10% headroom. We have a route policy ready but not enabled. Thoughts?

Alex: Agree. Enable as canary (10% traffic) during the window. Maya, can you flip the policy gate?

Maya: I can. Will enable gate for 10% canary at 09:30 UTC, monitor SLOs, then 50% at 10:15 if stable.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: canary-gpu-adjustment v2 -> infra-canary (triggered by Maya). Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/canary/1719994321

Sam: After deploy, I recommend temporarily increasing prewarm TTL from 30s -> 90s for eu-west1 to reduce churn while quota ticket is open. Patch in infra-ops PR.

Nora: Quick reminder — if GCP grants temporary quota, we need to update capacity spreadsheet and alert finance for any short-term spend bump.

Alex: Good call. I'll update the spreadsheet and notify finance if ticket resolves with grant. Blocker summary: waiting on GCP quota response; autoscaler import fix in PR; enable regional fallback canary.

Maya: Today's tasks: flip fallback gate (09:30), monitor metrics, approve autoscaler import once Sam updates.

Sam: I'll push fix in 15m. If anyone sees `insufficientQuota` errors spike, ping me and I'll toggle canary back to 0%. :pray:

Chris: I'll keep an eye on evictions and GPU OOMs — posting an alert if >3% eviction rate in 10m.

Alex: Thanks team. If nothing else, we'll reconvene in thread at EOW for capacity snapshot. :thumbsup:
